_comment: The single predicate registry for research-partner.
Three files have to agree about the predicate vocabulary or the vault quietly
and AGENTS.md (so agents write the right keys). Hand-maintained as three separate
lists, they diverge. Instead they are all GENERATED from
this file by scripts/init_project.py. Edit here, re-run `init_project.py config
bucket / inverse_bucket are Breadcrumbs field-group assignments. This is not
cosmetic: Breadcrumbs' Matrix, Trail and Prev/Next views read ONLY the ups /
downs / sames / nexts / prevs groups. A predicate declared in edge_fields but
left out of every group renders as 'No outgoing edges' on a note that plainly
has that edge. That was a real bug found by opening the vault in Obsidian.
A predicate with inverse: null is symmetric (contradicts, competes-with) --
Breadcrumbs gets one field, and the implied-relation rule closes it back.

buckets.ups: Toward context: the broader thing this note sits inside or depends on.
buckets.downs: Toward detail: the narrower things that sit inside this one.
buckets.sames: Lateral: argumentative and bibliographic links between peers.

core.label: about
core.description: This note is about that entity or concept. The workhorse edge.

core.label: part-of
core.description: Compositional containment. Drives the Breadcrumbs trail.

core.label: instance-of
core.description: This is a specific case of that general kind.

core.label: supports
core.description: This claim raises the credibility of that one.

core.label: contradicts
core.description: Symmetric. The single most valuable edge in a research corpus.

core.label: qualifies
core.description: Narrows the scope of that claim without refuting it.

core.label: evidence
core.description: Points at the source note backing this note's assertions.

core.label: answers
core.description: This note closes, or partly closes, that question.

_comment: NOT shipped into a new project. These are domain predicates from a worked example
project (indie-game economics) added on top of core, kept here only as an
illustration of the shape. Phase 3 proposes 0-6 domain predicates for the
project at hand and writes them into kg-config.json's `domain_predicates`.

predicates.description: A named worked example of a general pattern.

predicates.description: A number that serves as a reference point for that thing.
